notes.title: “Here is your mother”
notes.intro: From the cross, Jesus entrusts his mother and the beloved disciple to each other.

views.label: Mary is given as mother to all disciples
views.summary: Catholic and Orthodox Christians often read the beloved disciple as representing all believers, so Mary becomes a spiritual mother to the Church.

views.label: Jesus provides for his mother’s care
views.summary: Many Protestants read this as Jesus lovingly arranging for Mary to be cared for by John.
